title: Kata Rain
description: Katakana rain: columns of falling glyphs over a black sky, because this library would.
usage: A decorative downpour for the pages that can take it — launches, easter eggs, the 404 with a sense of humor. The glyphs are katakana and digits, the heads burn accent-bright, and the trails fade the way rain does. On any page doing actual business, this is the whole budget of mischief, spent at once.
a11y: Canvas only, aria-hidden, behind real content with real contrast. Under prefers-reduced-motion one frozen frame stands instead of the rain — the sky, holding its breath.
